Definition: from the base of G1166; a specimen (as shown):--example.
BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, in Jude's warning: the cities of the plain are set forth as an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire. A specimen, shown for all to see.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the example is given so that we will not repeat it: Sodom is the warning written in fire.
